# Megastructures — synthetic fixture for testing

megastructure_dyson_sphere = {
	name = megastructure_dyson_sphere
	entity = dyson_sphere_entity
	construction_entity = dyson_sphere_construction_entity
	portrait = GFX_megastructure_dyson_sphere
	show_galactic_map_icon = yes
	show_in_outliner = yes
	potential = {
		has_ascension_perk = ap_galactic_wonders
	}
	prerequisites = { "tech_mega_engineering" }
	required_perks = { ap_galactic_wonders }

	build_outside_gravity_well = no

	# Stage 0: Construction site
	0 = {
		name = megastructure_dyson_sphere_0
		construction_days = 1800
		resources = {
			category = megastructures
			cost = {
				alloys = 2000
				unity = 500
			}
		}
	}

	# Stage 1: First ring
	1 = {
		name = megastructure_dyson_sphere_1
		construction_days = 3600
		resources = {
			category = megastructures
			cost = {
				alloys = 10000
			}
		}
		planet_modifier = {
			planet_jobs_energy_produces_mult = 0.50
		}
	}

	# Stage 2: Final sphere
	2 = {
		name = megastructure_dyson_sphere_2
		construction_days = 3600
		resources = {
			category = megastructures
			cost = {
				alloys = 20000
			}
		}
		planet_modifier = {
			planet_jobs_energy_produces_mult = 1.00
		}
	}
}
